$comment: Language gate for the built site (scripts/zh-coverage.mjs). Starts `next start`, requests every prerendered route plus the dashboard once per locale cookie, and reads what a visitor gets: Chinese mode must be Chinese, English mode must carry no Chinese, and every icon a page declares must be one of the pinned files.

server.$comment_routes: The dashboard renders per request (it reads the session cookie), so it is in no prerender list, and the script skips app paths with a [segment] — every path here sits under [locale]. Named here so it is read.

$comment_skip: /privacy/ms is the Malay privacy notice: its own language in both modes, and it must match the English notice line for line.
$comment_icons: app/favicon.ico, app/icon.png and app/apple-icon.png — the same bytes covate.org serves today (checked 2026-10-29).
